title: Preserve all Unified BRAIN test failures as clustered root-cause candidates instead of only the first test
root_cause: Source verified: .github/workflows/unified-brain-delivery.yml read the first 'not ok' only when building one delivery-learning event, despite failed backend logs containing 355 separate TAP failures. Root causes of individual tests remain independent and unproven.
impact: Agents must repeatedly parse multimillion-character logs and may lose shared-root failure coverage; repeated chats create duplicate analysis.
failed_approaches: Treat a single first failed test as the entire run
Mark archived migration path symptoms as repaired without source verification
False-red initial regression expected tests/brain-*.test.mjs to immediately follow node --test; actual canonical runner combines multiple test groups before the BRAIN glob.
fix: Retain legacy first-failure canonical learning event, and add a deterministic redacted all-failures clustering JSON artifact in the SAME failed lane.
prevention_rule: Every failed Unified BRAIN lane must expose all TAP not-ok records with stable fingerprints, coverage vs #fail and grouped candidate classes; no class is a proven repair until exact-head test re-run plus required gates and canonical register evidence.
outcome: Candidate: complete failure triage without automatic fixes; require protected merge and actual failed run artifact readback.
